entry.title: Dungeon Tracer
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：5,99 € → 2,99 € [Gratuito ~ 5,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：2,99 €

Compras integradas

  • Todas as classes：9,99 €

Application Description

Sobreviva em masmorras infinitas conectando blocos para atacar, defender e curar. Dungeon Tracer é um jogo de exploração de masmorras em turnos que combina puzzle, roguelike e RPG. Conecte blocos do mesmo tipo para atacar com a espada, defender com o escudo e curar com poções. Cada escolha em cada turno determina a batalha e a sobrevivência. Os controles são simples, mas a estratégia é profunda. Ative efeitos poderosos conectando blocos por mais tempo e faça as melhores escolhas lendo os padrões dos inimigos e o estado do campo de batalha. Cada batalha traz um fluxo e escolhas diferentes, criando uma nova experiência de jogo. ■ Recomendado para: Jogadores que gostam de RPGs de puzzle e roguelike Jogadores que apreciam batalhas estratégicas em turnos Jogadores que buscam um jogo de masmorras offline Jogadores que desejam a diversão de criar novas builds e estratégias em jogadas repetidas ■ Jogabilidade principal Conecte blocos do mesmo tipo para atacar, defender e curar Combate estratégico em puzzle onde cada escolha é importante a cada turno Efeitos de combo que se tornam mais fortes quanto mais você conecta Desafio roguelike onde você começa do zero ao morrer Estratégias de sobrevivência que se completam em situações sempre diferentes ■ Batalhas estratégicas profundas A diversão intuitiva dos puzzles de conexão de blocos se combina com a estratégia de combate de RPGs roguelike. Seu estilo de jogo muda drasticamente com a disposição dos blocos, combinações de inimigos, escolhas de habilidades e combinações de itens. ■ 10 classes e 10 raças Cada classe possui habilidades e características únicas, e a combinação com as características da raça cria builds completamente diferentes. Experimente diversas combinações e crie suas próprias estratégias. ■ Diversas habilidades e builds Com mais de 40 habilidades ativas e elementos de crescimento, você pode completar seu próprio estilo de combate. A escolha de habilidades e itens resulta em desenvolvimentos diferentes a cada vez. ■ Monstros especiais e debuffs de bloco 43 tipos de monstros especiais, como lich, vingador, kamikaze e assassino, aparecem. Além disso, debuffs de bloco como congelamento, fogo, veneno, destruição e bloqueio mudam constantemente o fluxo da batalha. Não basta apenas conectar muitos blocos para vencer. ■ Desafio roguelike justo Um sistema aleatório determinístico baseado em sementes garante que em cada corrida e turno, os resultados sejam os mesmos. Aproveite um desafio justo onde escolhas e julgamentos são mais importantes que a sorte. ■ Crescimento que se torna mais divertido com a repetição Escolhas de habilidades que mudam a cada nível Design de builds focado em upgrades e itens Masmoas que se desenvolvem de forma nova a cada corrida Uma única falha cria uma estrutura desafiadora que aumenta a tensão ■ Classificação global Compita com jogadores de todo o mundo por pontos. Desafie-se nas classificações globais por dificuldade e deixe seu melhor registro. ■ 4 níveis de dificuldade Fácil, Normal, Difícil, Muito Difícil Oferecemos níveis de dificuldade que podem ser desfrutados desde iniciantes até jogadores experientes. ■ RPG premium offline Sem anúncios Sem compras no aplicativo Jogo offline disponível Com uma única compra, você pode desfrutar de todo o conteúdo. ■ Suporte a vários idiomas e salvamento na nuvem Suporte a 22 idiomas e você pode continuar seu progresso de forma segura ao trocar de dispositivo. Masmasmorras infinitas, monstros cada vez mais fortes e escolhas que mudam a cada turno. Quanto tempo você consegue sobreviver? Experimente a profunda estratégia de RPG de puzzle roguelike agora em Dungeon Tracer.

entry.title: Things 3
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：9,99 € → 6,99 € [6,99 € ~ 9,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：6,99 €

Application Description

Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals. Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organized—from routine tasks to your biggest life goals—and you can start focusing on what matters today. “Things offers the best combination of design and functionality of any app we tested, with nearly all the features of other power user applications and a delightful interface that never gets in the way of your work.” —Wirecutter, The New York Times KEY FEATURES • Your To-Dos Your basic building block is the almighty To-Do—each a small step toward a great accomplishment. You can add notes, tag it, schedule it, and break it down into smaller steps. • Your Projects Create a Project for any big goal, then add the to-dos to reach it. Use headings to structure your list as you outline your plan. There’s also a place to jot down your notes, and a deadline to keep you on schedule. • Your Areas Create an Area for each sphere of your life, such as Work, Family, Finance, and so on. This keeps everything neatly organized, and helps you see the big picture as you set your plans in motion. • Your Plan Everything on your schedule is neatly laid out in the Today and Upcoming lists, which show your to-dos and calendar events. Each morning, see what you planned for Today and decide what you want to do. The rest is down to you :) MORE THINGS TO LOVE As you dive deeper, you’ll find Things packed with helpful features. Here are just a few: • Reminders — set a time and Things will remind you. • Repeaters — automatically repeat to-dos on a schedule you set. • This Evening — a special place for your evening plans. • Calendar integration — see your events and to-dos together. • Tags — categorize your to-dos and quickly filter lists. • Quick Find — instantly find to-dos or switch between lists. • Magic Plus — drag the + button to insert to-dos anywhere in a list. • Share extension — create to-dos with content from other apps. • Widgets — see lists on your home/lock screens. • Mail to Things — forward an email to Things; now it’s a to-do. • Markdown — structure & style your notes. • And much more! MADE FOR IPHONE Things is tailored to the iPhone with deep system integrations as well. A great example is the Share extension, which allows you to create to-dos with content from other apps, such as a link to a website you want to get back to. You can also enjoy a beautiful dark mode at sunset, connect your calendars, add a variety of widgets, create to-dos via Siri, import from Reminders—Things can do it all! There’s even Shortcuts integration if you want to automate your workflows. MADE FOR APPLE WATCH Things comes with a great app for Apple Watch. Just raise your wrist to glance at your Today list, mark to-dos complete as you go, and dictate new ones on the fly—all synced instantly with your iPhone, iPad, and Mac. The more complex the elemental composition of the compound, the higher the score you earn, allowing you to find your own efficient scoring path. • Your score increases exponentially as the number of reacting compounds grows and the chain reactions last longer. Strategize your placement to achieve the highest possible scores. • From basic reactions like acid-base neutralization and hydrolysis to advanced organic chemistry, combine real-world chemical reactions to design and enjoy spectacular chain reactions. Explore the periodic table and collect elements. • Conquering numerous stages organized by atomic number, from Hydrogen (H, 1) to Krypton (Kr, 36), allows you to explore chemistry from basic to advanced levels step-by-step. • Every time you complete a stage, you can collect new elements or unlock new chemical reactions that expand the possibilities of your experiments and your scientific toolkit. • Upgrade each element to significantly boost your scoring efficiency. Application Description

Lead Japan's merchant fleet to import resources and export goods! Engage in trade, power up domestic industries, and drive the rapid growth of the Japanese economy! Japan relies on imports for many of its essential resources, with 99% of these shipments transported by merchant vessels such as tankers and bulk carriers. Imported resources are processed domestically into various goods for export, generating foreign currency. Merchant ships—including container ships and car carriers—play a vital role in these exports as well. Building a merchant ship can take two to three years or more; consequently, many shipping companies secure the vessels they operate by leasing them from shipowners (a practice known as "chartering"). Use your merchant fleet to handle imports and exports, activate key domestic industries, and fuel the growth of the Japanese economy! There are just two main tasks for the player: 1. Charter merchant ships! You can sign contracts by selecting the charter period, ship type, and vessel size. Once chartered, simply choose your trading partners and the goods to be traded, and the ships will set sail. 2. Operate essential domestic industries! By supplying valuable resources to these industries, you can manufacture products. These goods can be consumed domestically or sold as exports to earn foreign currency. Infrastructure that generates energy cannot be allowed to stop; oil, LNG (liquefied natural gas), and coal are vital to the Japanese economy. Make sure to keep imports flowing! It’s "Game Over" if you run out of any of the essentials for infrastructure and daily life: oil, LNG, coal, food, or money. Keep a close eye on your resource stockpiles as you manage the Japanese economy! There are absolutely no advertisements or in-app purchases—feel free to focus entirely on the gameplay.

Curves has Linear and Lab modes, and samplers — Depth Effect to enhance photos shot with the dual camera system — Chromatic Aberration to correct lens artifacts, Perspective, Black & White, Vignette with a controllable center point — All sliders are real-time and GPU accelerated — High-precision, deep color imaging engine — Export JPEG, PNG, and TIFFs (8- and 16-bit) to Files.app or Photos.app COMPATIBILITY — Compatible with hundreds of cameras, including iPhone RAW images. Application Description

Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter. IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients. Business calling features Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone: - Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation. - Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over. - Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension. - Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you. - Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call. - Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly. Works with your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network. On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket. Key features of the softphone - Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them. - Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8. - Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP. - Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications. - The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them. - Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account. - 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems. A softphone app without the fees Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it. Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers. Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.
